notes.title: Update 9/18
notes.content: Regarding LEVEL 11, a hint will be displayed after a certain amount of time has passed.

notes.title: Update 2025
notes.content:
Updated for the first time in 9 years!
- Visuals now match “PICO PARK” and “PICO PARK 2”.
- Supports online play for 2 to 10 players.
- Added Steam Input support.
- Now compatible with monitors running at 60Hz or higher.

We'll keep it free for about a week.

notes.title: About Update 2025
notes.content: [p]I'm thinking of updating Classic Edition for the first time in nine years.[/p][p]I kept Classic Edition because it's Steam-exclusive and supports 10 players.[/p][p]Since I'm doing it anyway, I'll update it with online support.[/p][p]I might charge a small fee for it. I recommend installing it while it's still free.[/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
TecoGamePad for iOS bugfix

PICO PARK update
 - you can set key assign of TecoGamePad on Game Pad Config.
